base_side.why: 08.10 door_side_tune: entry if the line or the model sees inside, exit only when both see outside; stride 6 = what the camera can do live. /doorside 22 stretches all days: in 29/29/33, out 25/27/30 (F1 0.906); leave-one-day-out for this scheme 0.906 (stride 6), 0.937 (stride 3).
base_side.why_birth: 08.10 owner: a track first seen inside at the door that within 4 s goes >= 8 % of the frame deeper and lives >= 2 s is an entry (went out and came back as a new track); deep in the hall or at the start of the data -- nothing. /doorside stride 6: entries 30/31/33 vs 29/29/33
base_side.honest: 08.10: SAM itself at stride 6 on the 22 /doorside stretches (micro1s6): entries 31/38/33, exits 24/27/30, F1 0.858 (model alone conf 1: 0.863); the same logic at stride 3: 0.93 -- speed is the lever
base_side.why_band: 08.10 owner: an exit counted for a worker on the ladder at the back wall (above the line extension, inside); the line now says outside only within 60 px of itself, and a crossing counts only with the feet within 150 px of the drawn segment. /doorside stride 6: 0.858 -> 0.871
base_side.why_s3: 09.10: stride 3 live (SAM 3.1 compiled + warm-up, masks at 1280, a pipeline: frames / SAM / people+events in parallel). /doorside 22 stretches, micro1s3 tracks, this setting: in 30/30/33, out 28/31/30, F1 0.935; leave-one-day-out over the whole grid 0.935 (stride 6 now: LODO 0.846). Births off: at stride 3 they only added 2 false entries (0.935 -> 0.921). Band 60 / near 150 kept for the back wall (no cost at stride 3).
base_side.why_live: 09.10: stride 3 without skipping. Sessions of 240 (sessions of 120 lost accuracy: 0.867-0.878 vs 0.935 on /doorside -- every session restarts SAM tracking). The compiled SAM is warmed on two sessions of a busy recorded stretch before the camera (new shapes recompiled mid-day cost 0.45-0.85 s a tick); the role model runs on the processor (on the card it pushed the memory over 12 GB and SAM to 0.5-1.4 s a tick). Busy 12 min of 18.09 at the camera pace: 226-264 ms a tick, 71-95 s behind, no frame skipped.
base_side.why_poster: 09.10: the detector-level stand filter (door_micro.no_poster, IoU >= 0.5 with the stand's box) also dropped people walking in front of the stand in the doorway: /doorside 22 stretches, compiled, sessions 240 -- with the filter 0.886, without 0.935 (the same counts as micro1s3). The stand itself never makes events: people() drops tracks that do not move (static_people).
base_side.why_trim: 09.10: SAM keeps every handed-out frame output of a session on the card; dropping those older than 32 frames: peak 8.11 -> 6.79 GB on a busy 240-frame session, masks and ids bit-identical on all 241 frames (sam31_trim_check.py)
